meta.title: Developer toolbox
meta.description: Developer utilities as a sidebar-foot Developer toolbox menu: open the submenu for the most-used tools (count adjustable, ordered by usage), or press Alt+Shift+Z (Ctrl+Alt+Z on web) for the full panel. Fourteen tools: JSON, encoding, password generator, regex tester, timestamps, color, ASCII, hashes, UUID, text diff, URL parser, text tools, JWT decoder and cron parser. Everything is computed locally in the browser; nothing is sent over the network or read from the session.
